categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes PeerManagerImpl::SendMessages in src/net_processing.cpp, the central P2P message dispatch routine.
categories.rationale: Decomposes the monolithic ~500-line SendMessages() dispatcher into 17 move-only helper functions, improving code organization and readability in net_processing. While it does not fix a bug or retire a specific protocol hazard, reviewers note it makes parts of SendMessages easier to refer to and review.
